evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce QuasiLeak-Bench, a benchmark for policy-conditioned quasi-evidence group recovery, which evaluates whether detectors recover complete quasi-evidence groups and flag the disclosures the given policy prohibits.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Existing privacy benchmarks focus on explicit identifiers, attribute inference, or task-driven disclosures, leaving inference from quasi-evidence groups largely unmeasured.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: However, a 4B model fine-tuned on our training split surpasses the strongest prompted model on held-out documents, showing that the task is learnable.
